Built a complete playable temple runner game in `index.html`.

### Included
- High-contrast cinematic temple environment rendered with Canvas
- Endless 3-lane runner gameplay
- Lane switching, jumping, sliding, relic collection
- Obstacles, fire traps, shield damage, invincibility frames
- Progressive difficulty and increasing speed
- Score, relic count, shield meter, power-up HUD
- Start screen and game-over screen
- Keyboard controls:
  - `← / →` or `A / D` — change lane
  - `↑ / W / Space` — jump
  - `↓ / S` — slide
- Touch swipe controls for mobile
- Responsive layout for desktop and mobile
- Visual effects including sparks, temple lighting, shadows, atmospheric background, and camera shake

### Validation
- JavaScript syntax checked successfully with `node --check`
- Served successfully at `http://localhost:3002/index.html`
- Screenshot capture was attempted, but Chromium is not installed in the environment

Assumption: I treated “Freefire temple run” as an original arcade-style temple runner inspired by that theme, without using official game assets or branding.
